description: Lightweight Calendly alternative with booking pages, ICS invites, timezone handling, and optional Google/Microsoft calendar sync. Single Go binary with embedded SQLite.
author: WisdomSky

tips.before_install: After installation, change `BASE_URL` in the app settings to your CasaOS address, for example `http://192.168.1.10:8080`. The first signup creates the admin account.

title: CalPal
